newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay June trade deficit $56.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay June trade deficit $56.8 bln.

text.p: Uruguay ran up a $56.8 million trade deficit in June, compared with an $85.4 million shortfall in June 1995 and a $62.4 million deficit this May, the Central Bank said Thursday.
Imports fell to $237.3 million this June, from $266.9 million the same month last year, and $258.6 million in May.
Exports were $180.6 million in June, against $181.5 million last June and $196.3 million in May.
Uruguay's trade deficit totaled $334.7 million in the first six months of the year, up from a $320.0 million shortfall from January to June 1995.
Imports totaled $1.43 billion over the period, compared to $1.41 billion in the first half of 1995.
Exports were $1.10 billion, compared with exports of $1.09 billion in the same period last year.
